text:
Silver Price in 2005
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2005, the LBMA silver price rose 31.4% between 2005-01-31 ($6.72) and 2005-12-30 ($8.83). The highest sampled price was $8.83 in December and the lowest was $6.72 in January. The mean of these observations was $7.39. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
